page: Microsoft Azure E48s_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Esv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 24 physical cores and 48 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor includes an L3 cache size of 260 MB, alongside L1d and L2 caches of 48 KB and 2 MB respectively. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance across several compute and memory metrics. The server achieves top 25% ratings in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, Passmark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Notably, image processing performance reaches the top 10% tier. Large-block read-only memory bandwidth is also strong, though the Passmark memory score falls into the bottom 25% category, highlighting a potential tradeoff in specific memory-intensive workloads.

The Intel Xeon processor supports advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for deep learning and matrix operations. This hardware acceleration contributes to strong performance in LLM inference prompt processing across small, medium, and large models. Given the 384.0 GB memory capacity and strong database operation and Redis SET performance, this server is configured for memory-intensive workloads, database management, large-scale text and image processing, and software compilation.
